changes.title: Terrace locked
items: In the treehouse, the Terrace and the DJ decks stay joined to the rest of the floor as you walk the rooms, instead of sliding about

changes.title: No empty beach clearings
items: Areas by the beach no longer have empty clearings in the middle: they grow as forest, since no runestone or soundsystem ever goes there

changes.title: Asleep before party
items: Before you cast the party spell, the forest is asleep, as after a party is lost: the animals sleep in their areas, can't be invited and leave you be, and tonight's find isn't out yet
Casting the party spell at your decks wakes everything up
